turns.why_empty: The M105 claimed_ability hint told the writer «say plainly that you have not done it»; the bare denial it wrote died as own_write_denied (the request does not name the verb «add»), and the accumulated third hint said both «say you have not done it» and «do not say what you did or did not do». The composer's last resort has no floor for talk, and the App's queue has no deterministic final for a conversation.

turns.why_empty: The App's failure lens read «No acepto que se ponga en duda mi palabra», a senator's words inside a headline, as a failure told over a verified read. The mind masks the words the headlines carry (_without_observed_search_vocabulary); the App's twin masked only web.search results.
